sources.title: 2026-09-16 FOMC statement
sources.policy_note: Federal Reserve Board public-domain statement retained as short attributed excerpts; no seals/logos or third-party content. Official FOMC calendar checked: latest scheduled statement shown September 16, 2026.

excerpts.quote: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.

definition.scope: U.S. policy decision and Committee assessment, not asset return or independently verified macro statistic

excerpts.quote: Economic activity is expanding at a solid pace. While uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient. Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust.

definition.scope: U.S. policy decision and Committee assessment, not asset return or independently verified macro statistic

excerpts.quote: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little. Inflation remains elevated.

definition.scope: U.S. policy decision and Committee assessment, not asset return or independently verified macro statistic
